company.name: BuildBuddy
company.shortDescription: BuildBuddy provides enterprise features for Bazel, an open-source build system that allows companies to build and test software faster.
company.description:
BuildBuddy provides enterprise features for Bazel, an open-source build system that allows users to build and test software. It captures build logs, invocation details, target information, and artifacts so users get a complete picture of each build. 

The company was founded by Siggi Simonarson and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud service that runs build and test actions in parallel across thousands of worker nodes to speed up software builds.
productsAndServices.name: Remote Build Execution (RBE)

productsAndServices.description: A scalable, globally distributed cache that stores build artifacts to speed up subsequent builds by avoiding redundant work.
productsAndServices.name: Remote Build Cache

productsAndServices.description: A user interface that provides visibility into build and test results, including logs, invocation details, and performance metrics.
productsAndServices.name: Build & Test UI

productsAndServices.description: A command-line interface built on Bazelisk that supports plugins, authentication, and handles flaky network conditions for Bazel builds.
productsAndServices.name: BuildBuddy CLI

productsAndServices.description: A continuous integration system designed specifically for Bazel to provide fast CI runs by maintaining warm Bazel instances.
productsAndServices.name: Workflows

productsAndServices.description: A feature allowing customers to provide their own encryption keys to secure build cache data stored by BuildBuddy.
productsAndServices.name: Customer Managed Encryption Keys
